verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a CLI, which can be authenticated with GREPTILE_API_KEY, and an official MCP server. Both are separate interface stories and do not show a documented public API with endpoints. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, and no REST or GraphQL API reference appears anywhere in the pack, so there is no direct evidence for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
